# T-2: Verify repair proof in gate readiness

## Goal
Bind current review and repair context into integration gate policy evaluation after validation artifacts exist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A complete matching proof passes must-fix readiness.
- A missing proof, duplicate match, pre-reportedAt timestamp, invalid RepairEvidenceReference field, identity/scope mismatch, or non-pass validation result blocks readiness.
- Diagnostic-only issue-log entries do not satisfy readiness.

## Implementation Notes
Keep FindingDispositionPolicy as verifier; integration reads finding fingerprint and reviewed tree/head from canonical review evidence, repairDiff from the impl-repair delta digest, and validatingTestResult from passing test-result evidence. Task gates must not request this post-validation proof. The audited preimplementation-bootstrap recovery is intentionally single-purpose: when existing implementation-target changes precede scenario validity, it records those exact paths, skips only scenario-validity and test-review, and retains test-execute, integration gate, and final-regression verification.

## Test Strategy
Policy and gate-readiness unit tests cover every required proof match field and retained diagnostic behavior.
